cases.question: main ekk 16 years ke larki ke saath ger sambandh karte huye pakra gaya main 15 saal ka hoon toh kya karu main
cases.why: JJ s.10 apprehension of a child alleged to be in conflict with law; s.12 bail; s.14 inquiry by the Board; s.18 orders; POCSO s.34 offence committed by a child is dealt with under the JJ Act.
cases.author: project owner

cases.question: My 14-year-old son was picked up by the police for stealing a phone. Can they keep him in the police lock-up?
cases.why: JJ s.10 a child apprehended shall be placed under the special juvenile police unit and not in a police lock-up/jail, and produced before the Board.
cases.author: assistant

cases.question: Can a newspaper print the name and photo of a 17-year-old boy accused of a crime?
cases.why: JJ s.74 prohibition on disclosure of identity of children.
cases.author: assistant

cases.question: Can a child who is accused of an offence get bail in India?
cases.why: JJ s.12 bail to a person who is apparently a child alleged to be in conflict with law.
